verdict.rationale: The pack shows a thin signal of rule-based automation: budget alerts can publish to Pub/Sub topics to trigger downstream actions when spending thresholds are crossed. There is no evidence of broader event-driven automation offerings like Eventarc, Cloud Functions triggers, Cloud Scheduler, or Workflows, which would be the core of this capability on a cloud platform. Missing for 10: documentation of a general-purpose event/rules engine (e.g., Eventarc, Cloud Functions event triggers, Workflows), independent corroboration of automated action execution, and detail on rule definition beyond budget thresholds.
